svg.title: SVG Image created as dual-radio-carrier.svg date 2026-10-24T16:35:52

g.text: Title: Dual LR2021 USB test carrier

g.desc: Title: Dual LR2021 USB test carrier

g.text: ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE - ERC/DRC and bench verification required

g.desc: ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE - ERC/DRC and bench verification required

g.text: Native KiCad ERC/DRC required; sample socket-fit checks pending.

g.desc: Native KiCad ERC/DRC required; sample socket-fit checks pending.

g.text: No hardware or radio performance has been validated.

g.desc: No hardware or radio performance has been validated.

g.text: Do not substitute generic LM/AMS1117 for ceramic-stable TLV1117LV.

g.desc: Do not substitute generic LM/AMS1117 for ceramic-stable TLV1117LV.

g.text: J1 = vendor P1; J2 = vendor P2. USB end faces carrier top.

g.desc: J1 = vendor P1; J2 = vendor P2. USB end faces carrier top.

g.text: 22.86 mm between rows. Socket pin 1 is at antenna end.

g.desc: 22.86 mm between rows. Socket pin 1 is at antenna end.

g.text: Top view: upper row module pins 8..1 left to right; lower 9..16.

g.desc: Top view: upper row module pins 8..1 left to right; lower 9..16.

g.text: Antennas connect to module IPEX4 ports at right.

g.desc: Antennas connect to module IPEX4 ports at right.

g.text: RF header pins 1 and 16 and NC pin 6 have no carrier traces.

g.desc: RF header pins 1 and 16 and NC pin 6 have no carrier traces.

g.text: DIO7 and DIO8 are reserved and unconnected in this revision.

g.desc: DIO7 and DIO8 are reserved and unconnected in this revision.

g.text: Manufacturer pinout image is an underside view.

g.desc: Manufacturer pinout image is an underside view.

g.text: Socket numbering here follows the documented TOP view.

g.desc: Socket numbering here follows the documented TOP view.

g.text: USB_5V is controller P1.21, downstream of its D1 diode.

g.desc: USB_5V is controller P1.21, downstream of its D1 diode.

g.text: U1 output is separate from controller 3V3 pins.

g.desc: U1 output is separate from controller 3V3 pins.

g.text: No external power input. Radio allowance 300 mA.

g.desc: No external power input. Radio allowance 300 mA.

g.text: Validate USB allowance, controller D1 heat, and voltage drop.

g.desc: Validate USB allowance, controller D1 heat, and voltage drop.

g.text: CS defaults high. Reset and initialize both radios at boot.

g.desc: CS defaults high. Reset and initialize both radios at boot.

g.text: Wait for each BUSY low before commands. One CS active at a time.

g.desc: Wait for each BUSY low before commands. One CS active at a time.

g.text: Start SPI at 2 MHz. DIO11 is a radio pin name, not ESP32 GPIO11.

g.desc: Start SPI at 2 MHz. DIO11 is a radio pin name, not ESP32 GPIO11.

g.text: Keep Wi-Fi/Bluetooth off for initial RF tests.

g.desc: Keep Wi-Fi/Bluetooth off for initial RF tests.

g.text: Same wiring and orientation as Radio A.

g.desc: Same wiring and orientation as Radio A.

g.text: Both sockets support either band and modulation.

g.desc: Both sockets support either band and modulation.
